opening_summary: Darryl Anka discusses Bashar's approach to predictions, explaining that Bashar distinguishes between predictions and probabilities. He clarifies that predictions reflect current energy momentum rather than fixed futures, and can become obsolete if collective consciousness changes course. Anka details three major predictions Bashar has made: the 2001 New York terrorist attack, the 2016 shift in societal trajectory, and an upcoming UFO disclosure event around end-2026/early-2027 that will confirm humanity is not alone. He emphasizes that contact will occur gradually with beings we can relate to before introduction to more alien species.
